description: ICT Liquidity concepts covering external range liquidity, sweeps, turtle soups, purges, and retail inducement traps.

topics.name: Internal vs External Range Liquidity

deterministic_criteria.external_liquidity: Major fractal swing highs and lows (BSL/SSL)
deterministic_criteria.internal_liquidity: Fair Value Gaps (FVG) and Order Blocks within the current dealing range

rules: Price expands from Internal Range Liquidity (FVGs) to purge External Range Liquidity (Old Highs/Lows).
Once External Liquidity is swept, smart money seeks rebalancing towards unmitigated internal PD arrays.

topics.name: Buy-Side Liquidity (BSL)

deterministic_criteria.trigger: Price trades above prior swing high
deterministic_criteria.target_pool: Retail buy stops and short seller stop losses

rules: BSL rests above previous day highs (PDH), session highs, and clean swing highs.
Smart money drives price above BSL to pair institutional sell orders with triggered retail buy stops.

topics.name: Sell-Side Liquidity (SSL)

deterministic_criteria.trigger: Price trades below prior swing low
deterministic_criteria.target_pool: Retail sell stops and long buyer stop losses

rules: SSL rests below previous day lows (PDL), session lows, and clean swing lows.
Smart money drives price below SSL to pair institutional buy orders with triggered retail panic selling.

topics.name: Equal Highs & Equal Lows (EQH / EQL)
rules: Double or triple tops/bottoms within 2 pips are liquidity magnets.
Never trade an EQH/EQL as genuine resistance/support; expect an institutional sweep.

topics.name: Liquidity Sweep / Turtle Soup

deterministic_criteria.bullish_ssl_sweep: Low < Prior Swing Low AND Close >= Prior Swing Low
deterministic_criteria.bearish_bsl_sweep: High > Prior Swing High AND Close <= Prior Swing High
deterministic_criteria.breakout_expansion_filter: If candle body Close breaks beyond swing point by > 0.3 * range, classify as BOS/Expansion, NOT sweep

rules: True sweep must leave a rejection wick piercing the level with candle body closing back inside the range.
If the candle body closes decisively outside the swing point, the setup is an expansion/breakout and sweep thesis is invalidated.

topics.name: Inducement

deterministic_criteria.location: Minor internal swing high/low formed immediately prior to an unmitigated FVG or OB
deterministic_criteria.filter: Reject sweeps of minor internal swings; must target major external swing fractals

rules: Internal range swing points often serve as bait (inducement) for retail early entries.
Institutional setups require purge of inducement into a major HTF key level or FVG.

topics.name: Judas Swing

deterministic_criteria.direction: Opposite to daily HTF institutional bias

rules: False morning breakout designed to run retail stop losses before real institutional expansion.
London Judas sweep of Asian High/Low frequently sets the High/Low of the Day (HOD/LOD).

topics.name: Draw on Liquidity (DOL)
rules: Price delivery algorithms seek liquidity pools in a continuous cycle.
Always identify the dominant Draw on Liquidity before taking an execution.
